title: Collections
subtitle: First-class holdings. Every record, index, search and face query is collection-scoped.
empty: No collections yet. Create one before importing data — there is no global namespace.
rebuildHint: Does not rebuild the rest of the platform.
faceHint: Upload a query image. Hits are candidates for human review — never identity.
faceDisabled: Face search is off in this collection’s index policy.
noIdentity: Similarity is not identity. Human review required.
required: Every import must belong to a collection.
wizardBody: Policies apply to every dataset you add later. Dataset fields may override only when allowed.
